equipment_type: Make-up air / heating and ventilating unit controller
applies_to: AbsolutAire gas-fired heating and ventilating (make-up air) units with the UC-3 or IC-3 control system and Smart-Vue user interface.
summary: The UC-3 is the unit controller on AbsolutAire heating and ventilating units. It joins a BACnet MS/TP network with a device instance built from its DIP-switch MAC address. The BMS writes network_ values for on/off, occupancy, setpoints, economizer and sensor overrides, and reads temperatures, commands, fan/burner status and alarm objects. The IC-3 user guide prints the identical points table.
default_device_instance: 3640 followed by the MAC address (e.g. MAC 25 = 364025)
notes: Taken from the Network Points List (p14) of the UC-3 user guide, which is printed as an image; the values were read by OCR and checked row by row against the page.

AbsolutAire's table also lists the controller's physical I/O as 'Hardware Input n' / 'Hardware Output n' (24 rows) without a BACnet object type, so they are left out. The guide marks them do-not-write; use the network_ values and status objects instead.
The IC-3 user guide (111021, https://www.absolutaire.com/wp-content/uploads/ic_3_user_guide.pdf) prints the same points table image, so it is listed here as an alias.
Many objects only apply with options fitted (cooling, economizer, building pressure, scheduling); the guide notes which.
Multistate sensor alarms use the controller's SensorReliability enumeration (no-fault / open / short per the guide).

integration.summary: Write network_FanCommand (AV 103) to turn the unit on/off, network_Occupancy (AV 134) for occupancy, and the heat/cool setpoints (AV 102-106). Writing 255 to the network space temperature, building pressure or occupancy objects hands control back to the unit's own sensors or schedule. Read fan and burner status (BV 21/22) and the alarm multistates.
integration.enable: AV 103 network_FanCommand is the point the guide says to use to command the unit on and off (0 = Off, 1 = On, 2 = Auto).
integration.remote_sensors: AV 132 network_SpaceTemperature and AV 133 network_BuildingPressure override the local sensors; write 255 to return to the local sensor. AV 134 network_Occupancy overrides the schedule (255 = schedule).
setup: BACnet MS/TP only. The controller detects the network baud rate after a power cycle.
MAC address is set on the 8 DIP switches on the controller (switch 1 = LSB, binary). Units ship with a factory MAC, incremented per unit on a project.
Device instance is fixed at 3640 followed by the MAC address (MAC 25 = 364025); change the MAC to fix a duplicate instance.
gotchas: Do not override the hardware points from the BMS: every override raises a Point Override alarm (BV 54-65). All control is available through the network_ values.
AV 111 Heat Cool Mode only applies with cooling; AV 112 Heat Vent Mode only without cooling.
AV 109 manual economizer is not available with the building pressure option.
